dse_runs.notes: NCO/DDS sin-cos, 1 sample/clock at >=250 MSPS, max_abs_err <= 2^-13, minimise LUTs. No system scenario. Prefer pipelined/pipelined_m families for throughput; keep accuracy_bits >= 13.

l3: not verified in this campaign: no recorded L3 row; a fresh exhaustive run (W=20) is too heavy for a live campaign
l4: no recorded synthesis for this design (L4 is not run live in campaigns)
final_text: The single spec `dds_250msps` is finalized. I spent its full 400-evaluation L1 budget on `run_dse`, which returned a 26-design feasible, non-dominated Pareto front (all designs meeting throughput ≥ 250 MSPS and max_abs_err ≤ 2^-13); the front was dominated by the pipelined family at n_iter=15, and the spec's min-luts rule selected `pipelined:data_width=20,n_iter=15,angle_guard=0,frac_guard=0,rounding=round` with estimated luts=979, accuracy_bits=13.6, ffs=1014, throughput_msps=264, max_abs_err=8.24e-05 (2^-13.57). The spec has no system scenario, so L2 `simulate_system` was not applicable. The ladder sub-agent ran L3/L4/L5: `verify_rtl` and `synthesize` had no recorded data for this design, and `back_annotate` returned `no_measured_data` — not a winner change, so no `reexplore` was triggered and the selection was unchanged. I then finalized the spec, recording the min-luts winner above; the `remember` call reported memory is switched off for this campaign, so no lesson was stored.
